title: session.completed (verdict) v1
description: Delivered by the configured real-session completion pipeline, not public persona simulations. Newer COLORS assessments may finish asynchronously after a completed conversation. Verify X-Groucho-Signature: sha256=<hex> over raw body bytes. This event is not itself approval or fulfilment.

id.description: Verdict row id (same as payload id).

client_session_key.description: Opaque session id from the client API

profile.description: Extracted applicant profile object when the selected completion/assessment pipeline produces one. This is not the string runtime profile ID on shared-engine message responses. Generic extraction settings do not govern every pipeline; see profile-schema-guide.md.

suitability_score.description: Advisory suitability, distinct from a recorded decision and allocation.

reviewer_report.description: Private evidence-backed reviewer report when produced by the selected real-application pipeline; not an applicant-facing field.

interaction_answers.description: Validated structured answers submitted for rich interactions during the session.
